typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (ids : List.{0} Nat),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.cost (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.testsDistinctM g ids))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.testsDistinctC (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g) ids)

source.code:
theorem testsDistinctM_cost (ids : List ℕ) :
    (g.testsDistinctM ids).cost = g.base.testsDistinctC ids := by
  unfold testsDistinctM Instance.testsDistinctC
  rw [allM_cost 1 _ (fun ij => accessC ids ij.1 + (accessC ids ij.2 +
    (natC (ids.getD ij.1 0) + natC (ids.getD ij.2 0)))) (fun ij => by simp)]
  simp only [Nat.add_assoc]

stepGoalPool.text:
g : GInstance
ids : List ℕ
⊢ (g.testsDistinctM ids).cost = g.base.testsDistinctC ids

g : GInstance
ids : List ℕ
⊢ (allM 1
        (fun ij => do
          let a ← getDM ids ij.1
          let b ← getDM ids ij.2
          tick (natC a + natC b)
          Pure.pure !a == b)
        g.base.tests).cost =
    (List.map (fun ij => 1 + accessC ids ij.1 + accessC ids ij.2 + natC (ids.getD ij.1 0) + natC (ids.getD ij.2 0))
        g.base.tests).sum

g : GInstance
ids : List ℕ
⊢ (List.map (fun a => 1 + (accessC ids a.1 + (accessC ids a.2 + (natC (ids.getD a.1 0) + natC (ids.getD a.2 0)))))
        g.base.tests).sum =
    (List.map (fun ij => 1 + accessC ids ij.1 + accessC ids ij.2 + natC (ids.getD ij.1 0) + natC (ids.getD ij.2 0))
        g.base.tests).sum

g : GInstance
ids : List ℕ
ij : ℕ × ℕ
⊢ (do
        let a ← getDM ids ij.1
        let b ← getDM ids ij.2
        tick (natC a + natC b)
        Pure.pure !a == b).cost =
    (fun ij => accessC ids ij.1 + (accessC ids ij.2 + (natC (ids.getD ij.1 0) + natC (ids.getD ij.2 0)))) ij
